style_base: Crude hand-drawn cartoon, Ecomonos style, PURE WHITE background, thick black ink outlines, flat colors. A brown cartoon monkey protagonist named Sara, huge white round eyes, exactly like the reference image, NO clothing of any kind, NEVER a human character. Exactly two arms and two hands per character. Any text that appears in the image must be in PERFECT SPANISH, never English, and only when the scene explicitly asks for specific words — double-check every accent mark. Fill the whole frame, no black bars. CRITICAL: NEVER draw a calendar, a torn-calendar page, or any day-counter with a number on it unless the scene explicitly asks for one. CRITICAL about the shadow figure representing the real-life hacker: this is a symbolic anonymous silhouette, NEVER a realistic depiction of a real person — its face must ALWAYS stay completely hidden inside a black hood silhouette, never draw visible skin, a nose, a mouth, teeth, or any facial features, and its entire body/hood is always solid BLACK, never brown, white or gray. Only two glowing YELLOW eyes are visible, nothing else. Never place two characters in a scene that says 'no characters' — treat that literally, icon-only, no monkey, no hacker, no people at all in those frames. Never add a speech bubble, caption, or extra label unless the scene explicitly asks for one.
